summary: Defines what XMPP addresses look like, including names that use characters beyond plain ASCII, such as letters from other writing systems. It relies on the PRECIS approach to internationalized strings. It replaces RFC 6122.

eli5.summary: An XMPP address is like a home address for chat. This says how to write one correctly, even when the name uses letters from many languages.

questions: what is the xmpp address format
how does xmpp handle non-ascii characters in addresses
